description: Sri Lanka Customs -  Rates of  Exchange effective from 09.09.2019 to 15,09.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how foreign currency conversions will be handled for customs purposes.
